parameter.name: hostname
parameter.label: Hostname
parameter.description: The hostname of your Volumio device

parameter.name: port
parameter.label: Port
parameter.description: The port of your Volumio device (default is 3000)

parameter.name: protocol
parameter.label: Protocol
parameter.description: The protocol of your Volumio device (default is http)

channel-type.label: Send System Command
channel-type.description: Sends a system command to shutdown or reboot the Volumio device. Use "shutdown" or "reboot" as string command.

channel-type.label: Stop
channel-type.description: Sends a Stop command to stop the player. Use "stop" as string command.

channel-type.label: Current Title
channel-type.description: Title of the song currently playing

channel-type.label: Current Artist
channel-type.description: Name of the artist currently playing

channel-type.label: Current Album
channel-type.description: Name of the album currently playing

channel-type.label: Volume
channel-type.description: Set or get the master volume

channel-type.label: Mute
channel-type.description: Mute or unmute the master volume

channel-type.label: Media Control
channel-type.description: Control the state of the Volumio Player

channel-type.label: Cover Art
channel-type.description: Cover Art for the currently played track

channel-type.label: Track Type
channel-type.description: Track type of the currently played track

channel-type.label: Play Radio Stream
channel-type.description: Play the given radio stream

channel-type.label: Play Playlist
channel-type.description: Play a playlist identified by its name

channel-type.label: Clear Queue
channel-type.description: Clear the current queue

channel-type.label: Random
channel-type.description: Activate random mode

channel-type.label: Repeat
channel-type.description: Activate repeat mode

channel-type.label: Play URI
channel-type.description: Play the stream at given URI

channel-type.label: Play File
channel-type.description: Play a file, located on your Volumio device at the given absolute path, e.g. "mnt/INTERNAL/song.mp3"

channel-type.label: Seek
channel-type.description: Jump to the given position in the current track. Plain numbers are interpreted as seconds. Write only.

channel-type.label: Track Duration
channel-type.description: Duration of the current track. 0 if the item has no duration, for example a web radio.

channel-type.label: Queue Position
channel-type.description: Position of the current track in the play queue, 0 for the first track

channel-type.label: Queue Size
channel-type.description: Number of tracks in the play queue

channel-type.label: Current URI
channel-type.description: Unique URI of the item currently playing

channel-type.label: Playback Service
channel-type.description: Volumio service that plays the current item, for example mpd or spop

channel-type.label: Sample Rate
channel-type.description: Sample rate of the current item, as reported by Volumio

channel-type.label: Bit Depth
channel-type.description: Bit depth of the current item, as reported by Volumio

channel-type.label: Audio Channels
channel-type.description: Channel layout of the current item, as reported by Volumio

channel-type.label: Streaming
channel-type.description: ON if Volumio is playing a stream, for example a web radio

channel-type.label: Library Update
channel-type.description: ON while Volumio is updating its music database

channel-type.label: Repeat Single
channel-type.description: ON if the current track is repeated in a loop

channel-type.label: Add to Queue
channel-type.description: Add the item with the given URI to the end of the play queue

channel-type.label: Remove from Queue
channel-type.description: Remove the track at the given position from the play queue, 0 for the first track

channel-type.label: Enqueue Playlist
channel-type.description: Add all tracks of the playlist with the given name to the play queue

channel-type.label: Add to Favourites
channel-type.description: Send ON to add the current item to the Volumio favourites

channel-type.label: Remove from Favourites
channel-type.description: Send ON to remove the current item from the Volumio favourites
